product_metadata.title: HOUSUIT Drawer Chest, 5 Dresser Chest of Drawers, Clothes Storage Cabinet Nightstand with Drawers, Modern Dresser for Bedroom, Nursery, Living Room, Ivory White
features: Sufficient Storage Space: 5 deep drawers and a wide tabletop provide ample space for sorting and organizing of daily necessities, such as clothes, socks, children's diapers, toys, and other stuff for a clean and tidy space
Elegant Modern Style: Add a timeless look to your room with this white dresser. The classic lines are softened by the curved legs, and antique metal handles add character and value to the furniture

Multipurpose: This storage unit is versatile and great used as a drawer chest in your kid's room, a wood dresser in the hallway, and as a tall nightstand in your bedroom, it provides the finishing touch to any room

Premium Material: Sturdy MDF frame, water-resistant wood board with white paint ensure long service time of the chest of drawers. The alloy handle and metal slides on each layer help drawers run smoothly

Easy To Assemble & Service: All accessories and instructions are well-included packages (include anti toppling devices). If you have questions regarding this product or need assistance don't hesitate to contact us
